instruction: Change Chrome's default font size to Large.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated Thunderbird Bills folder, opened latest X/Twitter email, found link (help.twitter.com), right-clicked 'Open Link in Browser' to open in Chrome. The link timed out (ERR_TIMED_OUT) and model spent remaining turns retrying. Evaluator expected amazon.com in tabs but got help.twitter.com which was unreachable.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird folder tree, open/select emails, read email content, identify links, use right-click context menu 'Open Link in Browser', switch between apps, interact with Chrome tabs
metadata.failure_analysis: Model opened the wrong link (help.twitter.com from X/Twitter email instead of amazon.com from AWS email) and the URL was unreachable in the VM environment (ERR_TIMED_OUT). Model spent 12+ turns waiting and retrying the unreachable URL.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests model's ability to navigate Chrome settings and modify a specific setting. This is a Chrome UI interaction task within demonstrated capability (model can navigate Chrome). Font size 'Large' = 20 in Chrome's settings.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome's default font size to Large (value 20). Evaluator uses check_font_size with chrome_font_size getter to verify the font size setting was changed to 20.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'chrome_font_size' maps to get_chrome_font_size which reads Chrome Preferences file and extracts webkit.webprefs.default_font_size - correctly targets the font size setting.
Metric 'check_font_size' correctly extracts font_size['default_font_size'] and compares against rule['value'] (20) using equality check.
Expected value 20 is correct: Chrome's 'Large' font size corresponds to 20px in Chrome settings.

Parameter handling is correct: with expected.type='rule', the framework passes the rules dict {'type': 'value', 'value': 20} directly to check_font_size, and the metric accesses rule['type'] and rule['value'] directly.
Complete coverage: the instruction only requires changing font size to Large, and the evaluator verifies exactly this.
No postconfig needed: getter reads the Preferences file on disk, not UI state that could be stale.
